translations.source: The gain determines how the amplitude changes for each octave. A gain larger than 1.0 will amplify the noise for every octave, while a value less than 1.0 will dampen it.

translations.source: Noise force strength. Higher values increase the amount of turbulence.

translations.source: Animation speed of the noise. Zero is a static noise. Higher values will make the noise pattern change faster over time.
translations.target: 噪声的动画速度。0 表示静态噪声。值越高，噪声图案随时间变化越快。

Sustain is the percentage inbetween the Base and Amount value, and this value will remain the same until the ADSR node is innactive.
